output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-fcbd42d1a107] is only a metric name, but the section intro [ev-1f419676f177] says what changes. Metrics that started with `cortex_`, including those in this list, will start with `loki_` in this release. Keeping the old prefix means changing `metrics_namespace` from its default `loki` to `cortex`, and that setting is deprecated. Together these give the subject (the metric `cortex_ruler_ring_check_errors_total`), the change (a rename to the `loki_` prefix), who is exposed (deployments left on the default `metrics_namespace`) and what happens if nothing is done (the metric is exposed under the new name, so anything querying the old `cortex_` name stops matching).
